name: side-roll-right
description: Lateral roll (cartwheel) over the shoulder, RIGHT. Lands back in the start posture (stand or sit). Two-button family: this repo feeds [0,1,0].

command.twist: twist = [0, roll_btn, 0]; roll_btn in {-1,+1} picks the shoulder; this repo feeds +1 = RIGHT roll. Start standing OR seated - the policy returns to its start posture.
command.head: unused (zeros)
